description:
• About our brand and products:

TraderInsight is a professional trader education company led by Adrian and Julie Manz, Ph.D. psychologists, professional traders, and long-time educators in the financial markets. TraderInsight helps active traders develop structure, discipline, market awareness, and repeatable trading processes through live market education, trading plans, advanced courses, and immersive Boot Camp training.

Our core products include the War Room Live Trading Membership, the NYSE Trading Plan known as Around the Horn, the Nasdaq Volatility Band Trading Plan, the NASDAQ Fast Ball XRV Tech and Biotech Trading Plan, and the Daily Income Trader bundle. We also offer advanced trading education courses, including Adrian Manz’s Income Trading Boot Camp, Harnessing Volatility: Trading Volatility Bands Mastery Class, Trading 2SD Opening Gaps Mastery Class, Trading ETFs and Financial Futures, Trading the Magnificent 7, The One-Hour Trader, and downloadable e-books.

• What makes us different:

TraderInsight is not a generic trading signal service. Our focus is education, process, preparation, discipline, and professional decision-making. We teach traders how to approach the market with structured plans, live analysis, volatility-based setups, behavioral awareness, and practical routines that can be applied in real market conditions.

Our programs are built for serious traders who want to improve their skill, consistency, and confidence. From daily trading plans and live market commentary to high-touch Boot Camp training, TraderInsight gives students access to a deep library of trader education and a relationship-based learning environment.

• How affiliates can earn:

Approved affiliates earn a 20% commission on eligible referred sales tracked through the TraderInsight affiliate portal. Affiliates can promote a wide range of TraderInsight products, including live trading memberships, trading plans, courses, e-books, bundles, and high-ticket training programs.

Products available for promotion include:

The War Room — regular price $299.00 USD
Daily Income Trader: Bundle and Save — regular price $399.00 USD
Around the Horn Trading Plan — regular price $199.00 USD
NASDAQ Fast Ball XRV — regular price $299.00 USD
Nasdaq Volatility Band Trading Plan — regular price $199.00 USD
Adrian Manz’s Income Trading Boot Camp — regular price $17,500.00 USD
Harnessing Volatility: Trading Volatility Bands Mastery Class — regular price $3,997.00 USD
Trading 2SD Opening Gaps Mastery Class — regular price $2,997.00 USD
Trading ETFs and Financial Futures: The Master Trader’s Guide to the Galaxy — regular price $2,499.00 USD
Trading the Magnificent 7 — regular price $1,997.00 USD
The One-Hour Trader: Financial Freedom in 60 Minutes a Day — regular price $597.00 USD
The One Hour Trader Professional First-Hour Trading Framework PDF — regular price $19.00 USD

• How to promote us:

Affiliates can promote TraderInsight through educational content, email newsletters, trading communities, YouTube channels, podcasts, blogs, social media, webinars, and other approved marketing channels. The best affiliates are those who serve active traders, options traders, stock traders, self-directed investors, and people who are serious about learning a more professional approach to the markets.

Affiliates should represent TraderInsight accurately and professionally. Promotions should focus on trader education, structured market preparation, disciplined execution, live learning, volatility-based trading education, and professional development.

• Other information:

Trading involves risk, and TraderInsight products are educational in nature. Affiliates may not make guaranteed-profit claims, exaggerated income claims, or imply that any TraderInsight product guarantees trading success. We are looking for professional partners who want to introduce serious traders to a long-standing educational company with a strong commitment to skill development, market preparation, and trader discipline.
term_and_condition:
Welcome to TraderInsight Academy! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.


1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.


2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliate may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.


3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.


4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.


5. Network

If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.


6. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).


7. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: support@traderinsight.com.


Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to support@traderinsight.com for support.
